findings.claim: Test 3 now depends on task 4 once the form sends a request, and nothing discloses this. The new block at lines 49-61 holds the POST. Then, if a request was made (if (api.releaseHeld)), it releases it and requires the overview heading 'Image Resizer', which only a fully working task 4 create flow produces. Observed in a scratch copy: the private reference with one task-4 bug, createService posting to '/api/service' instead of '/api/services', makes test 3 fail with 'Unable to find role="heading" and name "Image Resizer"', alongside tests 4, 5 and 7. A learner who finished tasks 1-3 on S32 and starts task 4 on S33 sees their passing task 3 turn red, with a message that points nowhere near task 3. The README's coupling note (README.md lines 60-61) says only that tests 4-7 build on tasks 1-3.
findings.recommendation: Prefer keeping test 3 independent of task 4: after the 'errors cleared' assertions, unmount or just stop, without requiring the created card. If the release step must stay, add to the README coupling note: 'test 3's last step also needs a working task 4 create; if test 3 fails on "Image Resizer", look at createService/sendJson.'

findings.claim: The new preventDefault check fails without pointing to a next action. On the shipped starter, test 3 now fails first at line 29 with 'AssertionError: expected [ false ] to deeply equal [ true ]', and the printed code frame (lines 27-29) never mentions preventDefault (observed on the final snapshot). The only pointer is the separate jsdom 'requestSubmit' stderr trace plus the new README troubleshooting line, which the learner has to connect by themselves.
findings.recommendation: Give the assertion a message, for example expect(submits, 'handleSubmit must call event.preventDefault()').toEqual([true]), so the failure names the fix.
